pagina.bajada: The people you tag in {marca}'s clips: add them once, with their username on each network, and mention them with @ when you publish.

tabAyuda.ELENCO: The people who are always on: hosts, regulars. They show up first when tagging.
tabAyuda.GLOBAL: The brand's directory: people who show up now and then and you want at hand.
tabAyuda.EPISODIO: Each show's guests. One who comes back can be moved to Global and stays in both places.

vacio.ELENCO: No cast yet. Add the people who are on every show.
vacio.GLOBAL: Nobody in Global yet. Add people who show up now and then, or move a guest here from their episode.

pagina.soloLectura: People who operate the brand can change this.

episodios.invitados: {n, plural, =0 {No guests} one {# guest} other {# guests}}

tarjeta.usos: {n, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Tagged in # post} other {Tagged in # posts}}
tarjeta.pasarAGlobal: Remove from the cast (stays in Global)
tarjeta.confirmarBorrar: Delete {nombre}? They'll disappear from Tags and from episodes. What's already published doesn't change.
tarjeta.sinUsuarios: No usernames: they won't be tagged anywhere
tarjeta.noEncontrada: We couldn't find them on {red}: check the username
tarjeta.sinVerificar: {red} doesn't let us confirm it: check the profile
tarjeta.fbSinId: To invite them as a Facebook collaborator, paste the link with the page number (profile.php?id=…).
tarjeta.noEtiquetable: {red} won't let us tag them (private, doesn't exist, or doesn't accept tags): they go as an @mention. Fix the username to try again.

form.nombrePlaceholder: As they're called on the show
form.enlaceNoReconocido: We don't recognize that link. Type the username for their network below.
form.ayudaUsuarios: One network is enough. Where they have no username, they're named without @.
form.aliasPlaceholder: Nicknames or how they're called, comma separated
form.aliasAyuda: Used to suggest them when they're named in a clip.
form.tambienGlobalAyuda: To tag them in other episodes without adding them again.

verificar.noExiste: We couldn't find that account on {red}: check the spelling.
verificar.noExisteOPrivada: We couldn't find that account on {red} (or it's private): check the spelling.
verificar.instagramPersonal: Instagram only lets us confirm professional accounts: make sure it exists on the profile.
verificar.facebookSinId: Facebook doesn't let us confirm it: make sure it exists on the profile.
verificar.sinVerificar: {red} doesn't let us confirm it from here: make sure it exists on the profile.

invitados.descripcion: Who came on this show: they're suggested when you publish its clips.
invitados.sumar: Add from the cast or Global

menciones.ayuda: Type @ to mention someone: each network gets their username.
menciones.sinResultados: Nobody matches. Add them in Tags.
menciones.teclas: ↑↓ to choose · Enter to mention · Esc to close

publicar.ninguna: You haven't tagged anyone yet. Tap a suggestion, search, or type @ in the description.
publicar.colaboradorIgAyuda: The Reel also shows on their profile if they accept the invitation. Up to {max}.
publicar.colaboradorFbAyuda: Pages only, not personal profiles. The page gets the invitation and, if it accepts, the Reel also shows on it. Up to {max}.
publicar.maximoColaboradoresFb: Facebook allows up to {max} collaborating pages.
publicar.maximoEtiquetas: Instagram allows up to {max} tags: the rest aren't tagged there.
publicar.comoSale: Instagram: tagged on the Reel and @username in the text. TikTok, YouTube and Facebook: @username (or their name, if they have no username there).
publicar.noEtiquetableIg: Instagram won't let us tag them: they go as an @mention in the text. Check the username in Tags.

enRedes.texto: The cast, the Global directory and each episode's guests now live in Tags.
